"'''Nails'''" was the nickname of a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was hired by [[Tarro Blood]] to get rid of [[Hunter (individual)|his rival]]. Nails was inferior to the hunter and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a deadly fight.<ref name="Settling Accounts" />
